force.description: Bypass the mtime cache and regenerate all context files unconditionally.

format.description: 'text' (default) for Markdown, 'json' for a structured response

mark_as_dev.description: For mode 'all'/'list', also mark processed plugins with .indevelopment.

mode.description: 'dev' (default) — only .indevelopment plugins. 'all' — every plugin. 'list' — plugins in the plugins parameter.

parallel.description: Opt-in bounded worker pool size (e.g. 4). 0 (default) processes plugins sequentially, avoiding I/O saturation on large installations.

plugins.description: Required when mode is 'list'. Component (local_myplugin), relative path (local/myplugin), or absolute path per entry.

mode.description: Plugin selection used: dev, all or list

plugins.description: One entry per processed plugin, in processing order

error.description: Why processing of this plugin aborted, when it did

failed.description: Number of context files that could not be generated

path.description: Plugin directory relative to the Moodle root

skipped.description: Number of context files served from the cache
